no-restricted-syntax.message: League-engine code reads time from an injected TimeProvider, never Date.now() (spec §23.1/§23.6; M0 D3). Use time.now().getTime().
League-engine code reads time from an injected TimeProvider, never `new Date()` (spec §23.1/§23.6; M0 D3). Use time.now().
Bare Date(...) always returns the current wall time regardless of arguments (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
Date['now']() is a wall-clock read (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
globalThis.Date routes around the time-guard (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
performance.now() is a wall-clock read (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
globalThis.performance routes around the time-guard (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
Aliasing the Date constructor routes around the time-guard (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
Aliasing the Date constructor routes around the time-guard (D3/R15). Use the injected TimeProvider.
new Date(...spread) can be an argless wall-clock read at runtime (D3/R15). Pass explicit arguments or use the injected TimeProvider.
